messages.text: Run the approved weekly release-readiness pipeline against version 4.2.0, pausing before any notification or tag operation.
I mapped the exact workflow and typed input digests, ordered steps, notification and tag effects, approval stop, retry limits, and separate evidence required before any effect can be claimed.
Make it useful in a normal chat client and leave a durable handoff.

I produced outputs/workflow-execution-reconciliation.json and a readable private handoff. The packaged example is explicitly illustrative and blocked; it records no Lobster call, approval, notification, or tag.
